```{r setup, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(data.table)
library(cowplot)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir="~/Devel/momentspp/test/")
```

Creating models

```{r, params, include=T, eval=T, results=F, message=F, warning=F}

# equilibrium models
Ns <- paste(paste(c(2.5e+4, 1e+5)), ";", sep="")
Ts <- paste(0, ";", sep="")

uL <- 1.25e-8
uR <- 1.25e-8

r <- 1e-8
s <- -c(5e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4)

params <- setDT(crossing(Ns, Ts, r, s, uL, uR))
n_models <- nrow(params)
fwrite(params, "params.csv")
```


```{bash dirs, engine.opts='-i', include=F, eval=T, results=F, warning=F}

source ~/.bashrc

rm -rf model_*

n=$(cat params.csv | tail -n +2 | wc -l)
for (( i = 1; i <= $n; i++ )); do mkdir model_$i; done
```


```{r, demes, include=F, eval=T, results=F, message=F, warning=F}

params <- fread("params.csv")
n_models <- nrow(params)

options(digits=16)
for(i in 1:n_models) {
  
  if(i %% 10000 == 0) {
    print(Sys.time())
    cat(paste(i, "\n"))
  }
  
  Ns <- as.numeric(strsplit(params[i,]$Ns, ";")[[1]])
  Ts <- as.integer(strsplit(params[i,]$Ts, ";")[[1]])
  u <- as.numeric(params[i,]$uL)
  r <- as.numeric(params[i,]$r)
  s <- as.numeric(params[i,]$s)
  
  sink(paste("model_", i, "/", "model_", i, ".yaml", sep=""))
  
  cat("time_units: generations\n")
  cat("demes:\n")
  cat("  - name: X\n")
  cat("    epochs:\n")
  for(j in length(Ts):1) {
    cat("      - end_time: ")
    cat(format(Ts[j], scientific=F))
    cat("\n")
    cat("        start_size: ")
    cat(format(Ns[j], scientific=F))
    cat("\n")
  }
  cat("metadata:\n")
  cat("  - name: mutation\n")
  cat("    left_factor: 1\n")
  cat("    epochs:\n")
  cat("      - end_time: 0\n")
  cat("        rates: [")
  cat(u)
  cat("]\n")
  cat("  - name: recombination\n")
  cat("    epochs:\n")
  cat("      - end_time: 0\n")
  cat("        rates: [")
  cat(r)
  cat("]\n")
  cat("  - name: selection\n")
  cat("    start_time: .inf\n")
  cat("    epochs:\n")
  cat("      - end_time: 0\n")
  cat("        rates: [")
  cat(format(s, scientific=F))
  cat("]\n")
  
  sink()
}
```

Testing steady-state stability for eigen/power methods,
different O(1-2p) and numerical precision (digits -> 16:double, 32:mpreal)

Log files have further details.

NOTE: ATM the eigenvalue decomposition is done with base Eigen 3.4, not Spectra

```{bash moments++, engine.opts='-i', include=T, eval=T, results=F, warning=F}

source ~/.bashrc

n=$(cat params.csv | tail -n +2 | wc -l)

for (( m=1; m<=$n; m++)) # models
do
  cd model_${m}
  
  for (( o=50; o<=1000; o+=50 )) # orders of 1-2p factors
  do
    # NOTE: we need not pass different model labels here because the matrices
    # remain constant for P variables
    momentspp param=../opt.bpp F=model_${m}.yaml O=${o} V=1 P=16 > log_O_${o}_double.txt
    momentspp param=../opt.bpp F=model_${m}.yaml O=${o} V=1 P=32 > log_O_${o}_mpreal.txt
    # Verbose (V=1) ensures that both eigen and power steady-states are output
  done
done
```
